text:
niya: dropping a short bring-up readout for marigold-12b (2.5k sampled chat flows). focus: cost vs quality and a minimal rollout plan for product/GTN.

ben: cool. headline numbers?

niya: metrics snapshot:
marigold-12b-int6 — p50 160ms, p95 380ms, avg tokens 410, cost/1M toks $21.10, GTN multi-turn 0.90
marigold-12b-int4 — p50 210ms, p95 600ms, avg tokens 410, cost/1M toks $9.70, GTN multi-turn 0.83

sant: ~54% cost reduction for int4 with a 0.07 GTN drop. where does the quality delta show up?

niya: primary regressions: multi-step logical reasoning, precision on numeric extraction, and a uptick in instruction-following failures for few-shot templates. conversational fluency OK for short sessions.

ben: what's your recommendation for product routing?

niya: suggested conservative mixed-fleet: default -> int4 for non-sensitive, short-turn traffic; escalate to int6 when: context_tokens > 700 OR request_type in ["financial_summary","legal_extract"] OR user_tier == "enterprise".

niya: rollout plan: canary 3% -> 25% over 12 days, with 72h shadowing on top-3 product flows and daily GTN diffs. gating slices: "multi-step-reasoning" and "numeric-extraction" (must-pass threshold: delta >= -0.03). immediate feature-flag rollback if exceeded.

ben: expected unit-econ after routing?

niya: back-of-envelope: all-int6 = $21.10/1M, all-int4 = $9.70/1M. mixed 70% int4 + 30% int6 => ~$13.78/1M (~35% savings). if routing pins 25% to int6 (long/sensitive) -> ~$15.07/1M (~28% savings).

sant: main risk is rare reasoning failures that might surface on high-value flows. any extra mitigation?

niya: extra mitigations: 1) add a pre-send classifier to mark likely multi-step queries so they hit int6; 2) log and surface top-20 failed samples each day to GTN/product; 3) implement an automated sample-replay job to validate fixes before ramp.

ops-bot: canary flag created: `marigold-12b-mixed-canary` at 4812345678. runbook: /run rollout 3% -> 25% over 12d.

ben: GTM one-liner for deck?

niya: "Marigold-12b int4 halves per-token cost vs int6 with modest reasoning tradeoffs; recommend mixed-fleet routing to realize ~25-35% unit-cost savings while routing sensitive/long-context traffic to int6."

sant: +1. please add per-slice CSV and sample transcripts to the onboarding folder and link GTN slices.

niya: will upload CSV + short triage note by EOD. ping me for raw samples. :thumbsup:
